integrity_statement: The sharpness proof is mathematical and all-dimensional; the supplied executable uses exact identities and selected finite sanity checks. Scientific acceptance reflects same-model review only, not an independent replication or audit.
scientific_limitations: Real coefficients and independent symmetric signs only; exponent four; precisely one missing corner of an n-by-n bilinear interaction array, n>=2. Does not determine higher moments, complex-scalar constants, multiple-hole patterns or a Banach--Mazur distance. Literature coverage is not exhaustive.
title: Sharp fourth moments for a punctured bilinear Rademacher chaos
